properties.name: Every served tool is reachable through find_tools from a description of the job in the user's own words
properties.statement: Anthony, 2026-09-11, stating the success criteria for the tool-sweep effort: "keep going until all 180 tools are actually available to the agent (I believe using find_tool)". For every served tool there shall be a query phrased as a user would phrase the job — not as the tool is named — for which find_tools ranks that tool in its top results. The evidence that prompted it: asked "which of my declared limits is being exceeded", find_tools ranked add_actor second and never returned budget_report, the tool whose reply is literally `verdict: "exceeded"`, while reporting 166 of 180 tools as matched. Not yet measured for the other 179 tools; that measurement is the acceptance test.
